title: Least singular values of shifted sparse random combinatorial matrices
summary: Let $M_n$ be an $n\times n$ random matrix with entries in $\{0, 1\}$, where each row is independently and uniformly sampled from the set of all vectors in $\{0, 1\}^n$ containing exactly $d$ ones. we establish quantitative lower bounds on the smallest singular value of the shifted matrices $M_n-z \mathbf{I}_n$ whenever $|z| \leq \sqrt{d}\, \log\log d$ and $ C \log n \leq d \leq n/2$ for some absolute positive constant $C$.
